_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::level_set#2 and a FALSIFICATION of its Signal. The entry claimed omitting VELOCITYFIELD defaults to zero so 'the interface STAYS PUT' and 'the level-set field appears time-independent'. On the upstream deck levelset_gaussian_hill_pbc that never happens: FourC::levelset_dyn checks the value up front and throws 'Other velocity fields than a field given by a function not yet supported for level-set problems' from 4C_levelset_dyn.cpp, so the run never reaches a time step and there is no stationary field to inspect. The check is stricter than the entry implied in the other direction too -- VELOCITYFIELD: Navier_Stokes hits the same throw, so for PROBLEMTYPE Level_Set the only accepted value is 'function' with VELFUNCNO. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).
expect_in_output: Other velocity fields than a field given by a function not yet supported for level-set problems

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: keep the prescribed velocity field, so nothing is omitted. The levelset_dyn throw vanishes and the arm exits 0, so the fixture must go red.
